All reproductive estimates use maximum likelihood. Temperature, laying-date and age figures retain the existing temperature-association models and their 4,000 clutch-size or 8,000 fledging-success joint coefficient draws. Year figures use separate models refitted without temperature in either location or scale, with 6,000 draws for each trait. Bands are pointwise 95% CIs and retain cross-component covariance. Year curves hold age and relative laying date fixed; all reference curves set random effects to zero and are not observed population trajectories.

[Temporal-model fitting](R/83_fit_temporal_without_temperature.R) · [Temporal export and checks](R/84_export_temporal_without_temperature.R) · [Temporal figure script](scripts/plot_temporal_models.py) · [Plotting script](scripts/plot_final_models.py) · [COM-Poisson numerical verification](R/75_verify_COM_Poisson.R) · [COM-Poisson prediction export](R/76_export_COM_predictions.R) · [Fledging ML fitting and comparison](R/81_fit_ZIyear_fledging.R) · [Fledging prediction export](R/82_export_ZIyear_primary.R) · [Environmental ML model](R/25_environment_temperature_location_scale.R)

## Temporal trends without temperature

The following year curves come from separate models refitted **without temperature** in both location and scale. Age and relative laying date remain included. Full estimates and interpretation are on the [Temporal trends](temporal_trends.qmd) page.

![Temporal models without temperature: (A) mean clutch size, (B) clutch-size SD, (C) expected fledging success and (D) the model-based measure of fledging reproductive consistency. Yearlings, relative laying date zero and all random effects zero; pointwise 95% CIs.](figures/Fig4_COM_M1_time.png)
